entities.name: Task
entities.description: A single to-do item with title, due date, and completion status.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: When the task is due; NULL if no deadline

fields.name: is_done
fields.description: Whether the task is completed; defaults to false

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the task was created; auto-set on insert

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Last modification timestamp; auto-set on update
